assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.subtitle: Answers questions about my profile and experience
assistant.greeting: Hi. I'm the assistant for Guillermo's portfolio. I can answer questions about his experience, projects, stack and availability.
suggestions: What experience does he have leading teams?
What tech stack does he use?
assistant.disclaimer: AI assistant that answers from the content of this site. It can make mistakes: confirm details with me.
assistant.offline: The assistant is running in basic mode (no connection to the language model). For a full answer, write to me directly.
assistant.error: I couldn't get an answer. Please try again in a few seconds.
assistant.rateLimited: Too many requests in a short time. Please try again later.
assistant.noAnswer: I don't have that information on this site. You can write to Guillermo at {email}.
